# Issue 295 implementation and verification

Target: `JeffreyEarly/wave-vortex-model#295`, v4.3.0 worktree `wvm-v4-cpp-adoption-audit`, branch `audit/v4-cpp-spectral-adoption`, starting commit `ba3b293cb44811258f9b6670771cbe7754cb9f3e`. The separate v5 checkout remains at `3f3da755e776ac5a17a597dd503369497acdbbad` on `feature/v5.0-free-surface-qg` and was not changed.

## Delivered contract

Default stratified `WVTransform.writeToFile` saves and `WVModel` output files now add evaluated `N2`, `rho_nm0` and explicit horizontal `k/l` for the C++ reader. These remain optional writer fields: MATLAB's required-property lists, constructors and readers are unchanged, and existing MATLAB files remain supported. Explicit property-only saves (`shouldAddRequiredProperties=false`) retain their previous behavior. The existing required `N2Function` is serialized MATLAB function-handle data and cannot serve as portable numerical input, so older files missing numeric inputs need to be loaded and saved to a new file in MATLAB before C++ consumption. The user's development compatibility exception applies only to C++; MATLAB must remain fully backward compatible.

`WVStratifiedModalReader` exposes standalone inspection and owning read of authoritative Stratified QG/Hydrostatic shared F/G scientific data. It does not enable their runner execution, decode their coefficient/forcing graphs, or implement the kernels assigned to subsequent issues. Current unsupported-transform runtime preflight remains explicit. The scientific contract `wave-vortex-stratified-modal-record-v1` is tracked independently from checkpoint/extension API identifiers and #357's execution contract.

The immutable record owns grid/rotation/stratification inputs, exact vertical and horizontal keys, preconditioners, equivalent depths, quadrature weights, `dLnN2`, and the four preconditioned matrices. `matrixView()` exposes borrowed typed source/name/action/family views; `groups()` supplies exact column membership. The shared slice has one group for all retained columns. That vocabulary can carry future discontiguous Boussinesq groups without radius-based inference, approximate deduplication or per-mode matrix expansion. Full Boussinesq wave-record decoding remains outside #295.

Inspection validates scalar types/values, matrix named dimensions/orientation, finite/non-fill payloads, physical coordinate and key constraints, rigid-lid boundary/barotropic zeros, unit-maximum inverse preconditioning, positive preconditioners/depths and quadrature normalization. It scans all matrix payloads through a fixed 4096-double buffer before read allocates any owned matrix copies. Geometry and duplicate-key metadata scale as `O(Nx+Ny+Nz+Nj+Nkl)`; no state-sized arrays, derived matrices, plans or output files are created by inspection. Failed inspection/read preserves an existing result. Files must remain unchanged during a read.

Prepared adapters produce unpreconditioned F/G reconstruction, projection and cross-family products using #357, in split or interleaved storage, with a caller-selected backend and accumulation policy. They prepare one derived matrix per exact operation/group. Horizontal specifications preserve the record's exact order, domain and forward-unit normalization. Scientific ownership, derived execution matrices and workspaces remain separate. No C++ eigenproblem solver or serialized runtime object was introduced.

Source identities are unique immutable in-process record generations, not path keys or approximate/content hashes. A fresh read creates a fresh scientific owner; reuse that owner and its prepared operators during ordinary time evolution. Prepared operators retain their own derived matrices and can outlive the scientific record. Changed geometry/operators require new preparation and old mode-set identities are rejected.

| Requirement | Authoritative evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Actual MATLAB persisted schema | The unchanged `WVGeometryDoublyPeriodicStratified.namesOfRequiredPropertiesForGeometry`, its property annotations, `WVStratification` and actual default `writeToFile` outputs with additive numeric properties establish numeric fields and C/column-major orientations. `TestStratifiedModalRecord` compares decoded arrays exactly, including all four matrices and `dLnN2`. |
| Profile/grid/truncation coverage | The main MATLAB method passes 12 cases: two variable profiles (exponential and tanh), `[Nx,Ny,Nz,Nj]` equal to `[8,6,9,4]`, `[9,7,10,6]`, `[8,7,7,1]`, antialiasing on/off, unequal horizontal domain lengths and nonuniform WKB vertical grids. A separate scientific slice selects actual MATLAB modes `[0,2,4]` from a six-mode basis and preserves their keys, matrices and retained-subspace identity. |
| Prepared normalization and mode output | MATLAB independently compares all six prepared operations (`Finv`, `F`, `Ginv`, `G`, `F*Ginv`, `G*Finv`) for split/interleaved storage; checks F/G retained-subspace round trips and zero barotropic G; compares exact-key gathered horizontal FFT coefficients with an independent MATLAB FFT calculation. |
| Quadrature and vertical calculus | Exact decoded preconditioners/depths/weights; quadrature integrates one to `Lz`. Decoded records reconstruct the F/G vertical derivative and antiderivative formulas and match `diffZF`, `diffZG`, `intZF`, `intZG`, including barotropic removal and the bottom-zero integration constant. This validates the scientific inputs/formulas; native model derivative/RHS execution remains the later kernel work. |
| MATLAB round trip and time independence | Separate MATLAB methods verify original-schema files lacking optional numeric fields through both transform and geometry loaders, and write and reload new default exports for both `WVTransformStratifiedQG` and `WVTransformHydrostatic`, compares scientific values, and verifies the complete C++ probe output is unchanged after editing `t` and `t0`. |
| Invalid/incomplete preflight | C++ tests corrupt preconditioners, equivalent depths, N2, density, vertical coordinates/keys, Fourier keys, G boundaries/barotropic values, F normalization, fill/NaN/Inf matrix values and quadrature; reject missing and transposed matrices. A 4101-level case tests late payload validation beyond the scan-buffer-sized prefix. Previous inspection/result owners remain unchanged on failure. |
| Setup failure and immutable ownership | Application-allocation failure sweep reaches successful read without publishing partial results. Scientific arrays remain unchanged by preparation and file mutation. A reread of changed preconditioners gets a new source identity and rejects previous mode-set views. Prepared execution survives release of the scientific owner. Typed raw views and exact group membership are checked. |
| Prepared allocation and storage | Ten repeated prepared executions count zero application new/new[] calls. Scientific matrix size is `4*Nz*Nj*sizeof(double)`; groups and derived operators are explicit separate owners. README explains vector/string capacity estimates and excluded allocator/vendor overhead. |
| Current consumers and portability | Focused constant/QG/runtime/extension checks pass, current ATS main builds unchanged and passes 7/7, public modal header has no NetCDF/FFTW/Accelerate types. AppleClang sanitizer and GCC modal-library gates pass. |

## MATLAB compatibility correction

The user clarified that MATLAB is widely used and must remain completely backward compatible; only C++ has no compatibility requirement. The initial three-line MATLAB edit was not safe: adding optional fields to `namesOfRequiredPropertiesForGeometry` also changed `geometryFromGroup` validation, causing old files without those fields to be rejected. The original round-trip tests used only new exports and missed that path.

The required-property edit was removed completely. After the user approved additive default writing, `WVTransform.writeToFile` now includes the four numeric fields only when adding the full reconstruction properties for a stratified transform. `WVModelOutputFile` adds the same fields when preparing model output, which constructs its own property list. Neither path changes required lists or reader validation. C++ parity and new-file MATLAB reload tests now exercise default saves. The older-file regression constructs the original schema from the unchanged required-property list, verifies that all four optional fields are absent, and checks both transform and shared geometry reconstruction for QG/Hydrostatic. A separate property-only save test checks that opting out of reconstruction properties does not introduce unrequested fields.

The earlier explicit-export correction passed four MATLAB methods, Code Analyzer, 5/5 source-contract tests and documentation checks. Final additive-writer verification: all 22 focused MATLAB tests passed (6 modal-record tests, 11 NetCDF handle/persistence tests, 5 compiled-kernel contract tests). This includes default QG/Hydrostatic model output read by C++ and restarted in MATLAB, original-schema reloads, property-only saves and all 12 numerical parity cases. Code Analyzer reports zero messages for both modified production writers and the modal-record test. Required-property source remains byte-identical to the starting commit; all scientific source-selection hashes match. The separate model-output writer discovery required one additional focused verification batch. The final `docs:check` passed with 2026 files, 4145 routes, zero failures and no generated differences. Final whitespace and source-scope checks passed; no package metadata, dependency, released snapshot or website output changed.

## Reproduction and handoff

Configure `PortableRuntime` with CMake, build `TestWVStratifiedModalRecord` and `WVStratifiedModalDump`, then run CTest with `-R '^stratified-modal-record$'`. For MATLAB, load the pinned dependencies through `tools/configureCIEnvironment`, optionally set `WV_MODAL_DUMP_EXECUTABLE` to the probe path, and run `UnitTests/TestStratifiedModalRecord.m`. Sanitizer configurations add `-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer`; the portable matrix-adapter configuration uses `-DWV_ENABLE_ACCELERATE=OFF`.

#296 can consume these scientific records and prepared services to implement the Stratified QG kernel; #297 then integrates current forcing/observer/output graphs. Hydrostatic shares the F/G data, while later Boussinesq work extends exact grouped wave records. Preserve `dLnN2` for complete displacement advection. #358's performance campaign is independent of this feature-completion sequence.

The implementation goal completed locally. The user subsequently authorized committing, pushing and updating the related GitHub issues. Publication targets `audit/v4-cpp-spectral-adoption`; main integration remains pending. No production source changed after the final successful verification batch, so publication reuses those results and checks whitespace, source hashes and repository scope.
